head: 25f6baaefc56e82a4fae5f679a43aa5f605d66f0
scope: Independent check of all seven drafted rows only; three compact time units and two other explicitly held rows were not drafted in candidate packet. No repo writes/tests/browser.

contextEvidence.readiness: Staff-only badge; counts derive from global module readiness, not selected app language.
contextEvidence.listen: Audio-only action rendered only when module has narration; narration player owns language selection.

rows.englishSource: All {lessons} lessons are illustrated, narrated in {languages} languages, and have slides and animations.
rows.candidate: Tidyondzo hinkwato ta {lessons} ti na swifaniso, ti na nhlamuselo hi rito hi tindzimi ta {languages}, naswona ti na slides ni ti-animation.
rows.independentBackTranslation: All {lessons} lessons have pictures, have spoken narration in {languages} languages, and have slides and animations.
rows.semanticCheck: The proposal retains that every counted lesson has illustrations, narration in {languages} languages, slides, and animations. “Have pictures” is a reasonable plain rendering of illustrated; placeholder counts are exact. This appears only in the global staff readiness tooltip, so it does not promise a voice in the selected language.
rows.uncertainty: Some technical terms remain as English loans (slides, animation); confirm the phrasing is natural.

rows.englishSource: Illustrated slides and narration are ready in {languages} languages. Translation review is still outstanding.
rows.candidate: Slides leti nga ni swifaniso ni nhlamuselo hi rito ti lunghekile hi tindzimi ta {languages}. Ku kambela vuhundzuluxi ka ha laveka.
rows.independentBackTranslation: Slides with pictures and spoken narration are ready in {languages} languages. Translation review is still needed.
rows.semanticCheck: Retains illustrated slides, narration ready in the counted languages, and translation review still outstanding. The global count is not presented as selected-language narration.
rows.uncertainty: “Ku kambela vuhundzuluxi ka ha laveka” is close to “translation checking is still needed”; confirm this is natural.

rows.englishSource: Reading and pictures are ready. Narration and slides are still being made.
rows.candidate: Ku hlaya ni swifaniso swi kona. Nhlamuselo hi rito ni slides swa ha endliwa.
rows.independentBackTranslation: Candidate: “Reading and pictures are present. Narration and slides are still being made.” Source: “Reading and pictures are ready. Narration and slides are still being made.”
rows.semanticCheck: “swi kona” means the reading and pictures exist/are present; source says they are ready. Keep the in-progress narration and slides clause unchanged in meaning.
rows.uncertainty: Replace the first sentence with `Matsalwa ni swifaniso swi lunghekile.` (“Reading material and pictures are ready.”). Check agreement and naturalness with a speaker.

rows.independentBackTranslation: It has been built completely / fully built.
rows.semanticCheck: The concise status says it is fully built. It does not imply a Sesotho voice; the badge is global and staff-only.
rows.uncertainty: Confirm the subjectless `Yi` works naturally as a status badge.

rows.candidate: Slides leti nga ni nhlamuselo hi rito
rows.independentBackTranslation: Slides that have spoken narration / narrated slides.
rows.semanticCheck: Names slides that have narration. The wording is a global category label, not a selected-language availability promise.
rows.uncertainty: “Nhlamuselo hi rito” is established in current Xitsonga locale copy for narration.

rows.semanticCheck: Means lessons only, as the source category label says.

Imperative “Yingisela” invites the learner to listen; “hi ku helela” gives the whole-module scope. It does not say which language will play. The source condition only exposes it when the expanded module has no deck but does have narration; player fallback handles language.
rows.uncertainty: `module` is retained as a technical loan, consistent with current locale spelling `module`/`timodule`; verify sentence naturalness.
